sloka: ब्रह्मक्षत्रं च तत्सर्वं यत्पूर्वमपरं च यत् ।युगयोरुभयोरासीत्समवीर्यसमन्वितम् ।। ७.७४.१३ ॥
transliteration: brahmakṣatraṁ ca tatsarvaṁ yatpūrvamaparaṁ ca yat ।yugayorubhayorāsītsamavīryasamanvitam ।। 7.74.13 ॥

translations.english: All those Brahmanas and Kshatriyas, both the former and the latter, were endowed with equal valor in both ages.
